The problem

Clinics lose patients when nobody replies: at night, during rush hour, or while the receptionist is with someone else. Patients message the next clinic on the list instead.

What we built

Replies in their languageEnglish or Roman Urdu, decided message by message.
Real calendar, no double-bookingIt checks the live schedule before offering a slot, and again before writing it.
Knows when to stopPain or urgency words, or a request for a person, alert staff immediately.
Staff appToday's schedule, new bookings and urgent alerts on Android, with take-over in one tap.

How it works

Each message goes through one engine shared by WhatsApp and the website chat. The model can only answer availability by calling the booking tool, which reads the clinic's real calendar. Low confidence, urgency or a repeated question hands the thread to a human, who can take over mid-conversation.

Status, honestly

Available now for clinics and service businesses in Pakistan. We set it up on your own business as a free demo before you decide.
